name: PWA Template
note: Template only: it declares the full catalogue an installed PWA MAY request. A real app is launched with the SUBSET a user granted; nothing here is granted by copying this file.

landlock_rules.kernel_note: INTENT ONLY on this device: Landlock requires Linux >= 5.13 and the S10+ vendor kernel is 4.14.253. nuxel-sandbox reports LANDLOCK_UNAVAILABLE and continues.

network_policy.kernel_note: Per-app matching on 4.14 uses the cgroup v1 net_cls classid; the cgroupv2 matcher requires Linux >= 5.13.

enforcement.apparmor: generated per installed app from configs/apparmor.d/usr.bin.nuxel-pwa-launcher; effective only if AppArmor is enabled in this kernel
enforcement.note: A denied capability is a real refusal from the portal; it is not a kernel-level denial of the underlying device, because 4.14 has no Landlock.
